history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration develop detailed guidelines to outline the steps of the performance management process to ensure accountability, including for resident coordinators ad interim, regardless of the tenure of their appointment.
history.administration_response: Appraising only resident coordinators and resident coordinators ad interim who have been in post at least for six months is in line with the practice of the United Nations Secretariat and the broader United Nations system. Resident coordinators ad interim who are in office for less than six months are being held accountable on a continuous basis by the Development Coordination Office regional directors, who meet with them virtually at least once per month – and usually more often, depending on the country situation. Thus, the lack of a performance appraisal does not equate to lack of accountability. Detailed guidelines have been developed to outline the performance management process for both resident coordinators and resident coordinators ad interim, regardless of the duration of their assignment. Given the above context, the Board is requested to consider closing this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that detailed guidelines have been developed to outline the performance management process for both resident coordinators and resident coordinators ad interim, regardless of the duration of their assignment, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
